title: Coherent scalar comparisons for normalized recollement presentations
statement: Fix a prime $l$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_l$, a field $k$ with $l$ invertible, a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $X$, and complementary closed and open immersions $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$, $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ over $k$. Suppose $P_L$ and $Q_L$ are integral and rational recollement presentations at every finite coefficient field $L\subset\Omega$, normalized as in [def-sf-recollement-presentation-data]. Write $T_{M/L}$ for the actual scalar transition of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], and $a_{L,M,N}$ for its associator. There exist natural isomorphisms $b^o_{M/L}:Q_L^o T_{M/L}\simeq T_{M/L}Q_M^o$ and $b^c_{M/L}:Q_L^c T_{M/L}\simeq T_{M/L}Q_M^c$. For either vertex $V=o,c$, their components satisfy $T_{N/M}(b^V_{M/L,K})b^V_{N/M,T_{M/L}K}Q_N^V(a_{L,M,N,K})=a_{L,M,N,Q_L^VK}b^V_{N/L,K}$ for every tower $L\subset M\subset N$. They preserve the prescribed maps: $T_{M/L}(\epsilon_{L,K})=b^o_{M/L,K}\epsilon_{M,T_{M/L}K}$ and $T_{M/L}(\eta_{L,K})b^c_{M/L,K}=\eta_{M,T_{M/L}K}$. This statement concerns only the finite rational coefficient categories and asserts no descended functor, triangle, or Hom vanishing.

proof.text: On the ordinary completed sheaf categories, coefficient extension commutes with closed pullback and direct image and with their adjunction unit. It is exact, so it carries the kernel presentation with its inclusion to the corresponding kernel presentation over the larger coefficient field. The coefficient-operation comparisons preserve units and counits.

proof.text: Compare each integral presentation with this ordinary presentation using the defining normalization on complexes. Essential surjectivity of derived localization and naturality extend the two map squares from representative complexes to all objects. Conjugate the ordinary scalar comparisons by these isomorphisms.

proof.text: Apply raw rationalization and conjugate by the given rational normalization comparisons. Tensor associativity and its coherence identify the two composites in every coefficient tower; the intermediate normalization comparisons cancel. Kernel universality gives the same equation for the open term. The unit and counit squares are preserved under conjugation and localization. Repeated fields and empty complements require no separate nonvanishing assumption.

theorem sfNormalizedRecollement_scalar_coherence
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (_hk : IsUnit (l : k))
    {Z U X : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [U.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : U ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion j]
    [j.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    (_hij : Set.range j.base = (Set.range i.base)ᶜ)
    (P : ∀ L : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω,
      SfRecollementPresentation (sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l
        (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) X))
    (Q : ∀ L : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω,
      SfRecollementPresentation (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Ω X L))
    (hPQ : ∀ L, SfIntegralRecollementNormalization l
        (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) i
        (sfRecollementNoetherian k X) (P L) ∧
      SfRationalRecollementNormalization l
        (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) X (P L) (Q L)) :
    ∃ (a : ∀ {L M : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω} (h : L ≤ M),
        (Q L).openTerm ⋙ (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X).T h ≅
          (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X).T h ⋙ (Q M).openTerm)
      (c : ∀ {L M : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω} (h : L ≤ M),
        (Q L).closedTerm ⋙ (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X).T h ≅
          (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X).T h ⋙ (Q M).closedTerm),
      CategoryTheory.StageSystem.pairFunctorCoherent
        (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X)
        (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X)
        (fun L ↦ (Q L).openTerm) a ∧
      CategoryTheory.StageSystem.pairFunctorCoherent
        (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X)
        (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X)
        (fun L ↦ (Q L).closedTerm) c ∧
      (∀ {L M : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω} (h : L ≤ M) K,
        ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X).T h).map
            ((Q L).counit.app K) =
          (a h).hom.app K ≫ (Q M).counit.app
            (((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X).T h).obj K)) ∧
      ∀ {L M : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω} (h : L ≤ M) K,
        ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X).T h).map
            ((Q L).unit.app K) ≫ (c h).hom.app K =
          (Q M).unit.app
            (((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X).T h).obj K)
